messages:
mike (support): FYI — incoming enterprise ask from PineBank via a support ticket: they want first-class SSO + SCIM support for our Terraform provider and a JS SDK listing in marketplace. quoted from customer: 'we need SCIM provisioning + SSO SAML or OIDC for workforce provisioning. Terraform provider should map to our infra-as-code flows.' Ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/9876

elena (PM): Thanks — can you paste the ticket text here (or the key asks) and note the expected go-live window? Are they asking for SCIM push (provisioning) or just user/group sync read-only?

mike (support): Ticket summary: SCIM push provisioning (create/update/deactivate), group sync, SSO via SAML + OIDC optional. They want the Terraform provider to accept an auth method that can be bound to the org (service account K/V). Target: Q3 pilot, production by Oct if we can commit. They called it high priority and are open to a paid integration contract.

elena (PM): Ok. High-level product ask: two deliverables — (A) SCIM + SSO support in Identity layer (works for Redwood hosted and Private customers) (B) Terraform provider auth + docs + marketplace listing + a JS SDK marketplace package. We need acceptance criteria for both before we scope.

chloe (devex): For marketplace JS SDK listing: packaging + TS types + quickstart + example workspace. Also we should provide a sample Terraform module that demonstrates org-level provisioning. That reduces integration friction. Docs + code samples are ~3-5 days once API exists.

raj (eng): Technical questions: 1) SCIM push means we need provisioning endpoints and a provisioning token tied to org, with audit logs. 2) Terraform provider change: add a provider resource to configure SCIM connectors and auth, or support OAuth/service account flow? 3) SAML vs OIDC — which protocol is required for MVP?

mike (support): Customer prefers SAML for SSO, but OIDC acceptable. They asked SAML first.

elena (PM): Proposal for MVP scope to limit risk: support SCIM push (create/update/deactivate) + SAML SSO for enterprise SSO. Terraform provider: allow a provider block to reference a managed service account token (no UI). JS SDK marketplace: publish a minimal package with auth helper and example. Advanced features (UI-driven provisioning, SCIM delta optimizations) in follow-ups.

raj (eng): Rough estimate: SCIM API + auth + audit + tests = 2 devs x ~3 sprints (including infra & security review). Provider + SDK + docs = 1-2 devs x 1-2 sprints. Needs a short spike (3-4d) to confirm edge cases (group membership mappings, SCIM rate limits).

devon (sales): PineBank is willing to pay for an accelerated delivery and sign an MSA addendum. They also want early access to the Terraform examples for their infra team. If we can promise alpha by mid-Aug, they'll push for it.

elena (PM): Ok assume commercial support. Decision points: timeline commitment, owner, acceptance criteria, security/privacy checklist. I propose we tag backlog and create two epics: EPIC-identity-scim-sso and EPIC-integ-provider-marketplace. Owner: eng-ecosys (raj), PM: elena, DevEx: chloe, Sales owner: devon.

product-bot: Created ticket INT-9876 and applied labels: integration:sso-scim, prio:customer-high, area:ecosystem.

chloe (devex): Suggested acceptance criteria (scim): 1) SCIM endpoints support create/update/deactivate for users and groups, 2) SCIM provisioning token tied to org with rotate endpoint, 3) audit logs surfaced in console and via export, 4) end-to-end test using a test IdP. For provider/SDK: 1) provider supports auth via org token, 2) examples in repo + CI tests, 3) marketplace listing with quickstart and license file.

raj (eng): Also add non-functional criteria: rate limiting behavior documented, 99th pct latency SLO for provisioning endpoints, rolling deployment plan for Private customers. Security to sign off on HSM/KMS usage for tokens.

elena (PM): Good. Next steps: 1) spike (3-4d) to clarify SCIM edge cases & provider auth (owner: raj) 2) create epics + ACs in board (owner: elena) 3) sales commit from PineBank (devon to confirm) 4) schedule security design review (sec eng) 5) DevEx to draft marketplace checklist (owner: chloe). Can everyone ack?

mike (support): Acked. I've also pinged the PineBank CSM to ask for their exact SAML IdP metadata and sample user CSV.

devon (sales): Ack. I'll push for the contract addendum and early access notes.

raj (eng): Ack. I'll spin up the spike ticket and link any findings by EOD Friday.

chloe (devex): Ack. I'll draft the marketplace checklist and sample Terraform module template by next Tue.

elena (PM): Great. I'll create the two epics and attach acceptance criteria. Tentative timeline: spike this week, dev work next 6 weeks, aim for customer alpha in mid-Aug if commercial timeline holds. We'll reconvene after spike. :calendar:

product-bot: Labels updated: owner:eng-ecosys, roadmap:considered, release-window:Q3
